executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues: (1) Type mismatches between Priority and TaskPriority enums, (2) Incorrect type conversions (long to UUID/String), (3) Service method signature mismatches requiring additional userId parameter, (4) Missing methods in GlobalExceptionHandler and InMemoryTaskDataStore classes.

errors.message: incompatible types: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority (multiple occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses Priority enum but the application expects TaskPriority enum. This indicates a mismatch between DTO definitions and test expectations.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update TaskCreateRequest and TaskUpdateRequest DTOs to use Priority enum instead of TaskPriority, or update all test cases to use TaskPriority enum consistently.

errors.message: incompatible types: long cannot be converted to UUID (multiple occurrences)
errors.root_cause: Test code uses long primitive for task IDs but the application now uses UUID type for task identifiers.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all test cases to use UUID.randomUUID() instead of long values for task IDs. Replace all instances of 'long taskId = 1L' with 'UUID taskId = UUID.randomUUID()'.

errors.message: method createTask requires userId parameter: found TaskCreateRequest, required String,TaskCreateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter, but test mocks only provide TaskCreateRequest.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all when(taskService.createTask(...)) mock statements to include userId parameter: when(taskService.createTask(anyString(), any(TaskCreateRequest.class))).

errors.message: method getUserTasks requires 4 parameters: found long,int,int, required String,int,int,String
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature changed to require userId (String) and sortBy parameter, but tests pass long userId and only 3 parameters.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all getUserTasks() calls to: when(taskService.getUserTasks(anyString(), anyInt(), anyInt(), anyString())). Convert userId from long to String.

errors.message: method bulkCreateTasks requires userId: found Object, required String,List<TaskCreateRequest>
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update bulkCreateTasks mock to: when(taskService.bulkCreateTasks(anyString(), anyList())). Add userId parameter to all bulk operation calls.

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler class does not have a handleValidationErrors() method, but tests expect it to exist.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add @ExceptionHandler method in GlobalExceptionHandler: @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class) public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidationErrors(MethodArgumentNotValidException ex).

errors.message: incompatible types: long cannot be converted to String, Priority to TaskPriority (multiple occurrences)
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore expects String userId and TaskPriority enum, but tests provide long userId and Priority enum.
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest to use String for userId (e.g., 'user-123') and TaskPriority enum instead of Priority enum throughout all test methods.

errors.message: cannot find symbol: method findAll(), existsById()
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore class is missing findAll() and existsById() methods that tests expect to exist.
errors.fix_recommendation: Add public List<Task> findAll() and public boolean existsById(UUID taskId) methods to InMemoryTaskDataStore class.

summary: 8 grouped compilation error categories found (100 individual errors)
